## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was that the test schema definitions in `/testbed/tests/schemas.py` had been deliberately corrupted with swapped field types. The schema classes had their field types mixed up:

- `fields.Int()` fields were replaced with `fields.Str()` or `fields.List(fields.Str())`
- `fields.Str()` fields were replaced with `fields.Int()`
- `fields.Nested()` references were replaced with `fields.List(fields.Str())` or `fields.Str()`
- `fields.List(fields.Nested(...))` was replaced with `fields.Int()`

This caused the marshmallow extension to generate incorrect OpenAPI schema definitions, leading to test failures where the expected types didn't match the generated types.

The fix was to restore the original, correct schema definitions using `git checkout HEAD -- tests/schemas.py`, which reverted the file to its proper state with correctly typed fields.
